title: AI + Science
description: We address major scientific needs in protein design, fusion energy, and high-energy physics by integrating reinforcement learning, scientific generative models, and scientific foundation models into real research settings.

title: World Models & Virtual Cell
description: We explore interaction-driven modeling of the physical world to develop generalizable, sample-efficient, and interpretable world models, extending these methods toward virtual-cell digital twins and dynamic molecular simulation.

title: AI + XR Experimental Platform
description: With Science One as the cognitive core, we combine XR, vision-language models, and collaborative robots to understand experiments, provide real-time guidance, correct errors, and continuously record scientific data.
